# PocketShell

> A self-hosted, mobile-first remote terminal. Sessions live in server-side tmux, so losing signal never kills the task; reconnecting replays only the output you missed; and a push notification reaches your phone when an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Kimi CLI) finishes a round or waits for your input. One binary, Noise IK end-to-end encryption, Apache-2.0.

PocketShell is not a cloud service and not an IDE. It assumes you already have tmux and a Linux or macOS machine that stays on, and it covers the stretch where you are away from that machine. Your code never leaves your own hardware: the agent runs on your host and the phone is only a screen.

## Site

- [Home (English)](https://pocketshell.net/): what it is, how resilient sessions and replay work, feature overview including the three selectable key layouts, comparison with a mobile SSH client, three-step install
- [首页（中文）](https://pocketshell.net/zh): the same page in Chinese
- [Full demo video](https://pocketshell.net/#video): a 40-second unedited walkthrough — unlock the phone, open the app from the home screen, start a tmux session, launch Claude Code from a saved snippet, compose the whole request in the system keyboard and send it, lock the phone and walk away, get a push on the lock screen when the task finishes, tap it and read the answer
- [Live demo](https://demo.pocketshell.net): the real frontend running against a simulated agent — no install, no host, no signup. Best on a phone; a desktop visit shows the app inside a phone frame. Includes a "try going offline" button that drops the connection for real and replays the missed output on reconnect

## Articles

- [Run Claude Code from your phone](https://pocketshell.net/blog/run-claude-code-from-your-phone): overview of every approach — the official Claude app, Remote Control, cloud sessions, CloudCLI, SSH + tmux, and PocketShell — with when each one fits
- [Claude Code remote control not working](https://pocketshell.net/blog/claude-code-remote-control-not-working): the three most common causes a Remote Control session hangs or drops, and what fixes each
- [Keep Claude Code running after an SSH disconnect](https://pocketshell.net/blog/keep-claude-code-running-after-ssh-disconnect): why the process dies with the connection, why `nohup` doesn't save it, and how tmux, screen, zellij, and mosh each address a different part of it
- [Get a notification when Claude Code finishes](https://pocketshell.net/blog/claude-code-notification-when-done): four ways to find out a task is done or stuck without watching the terminal
- [Claude Code on iPad](https://pocketshell.net/blog/claude-code-on-ipad): three genuinely different paths — official app, SSH client, remote desktop/VNC — and where each one falls short
- [CloudCLI (claudecodeui) stuck on mobile](https://pocketshell.net/blog/claude-code-ui-mobile-session-freeze): two known mobile issues in CloudCLI, their GitHub issue numbers and root causes, and a different architecture that avoids the same failure mode
- [Every way to run Claude Code from your phone, compared](https://pocketshell.net/blog/claude-code-mobile-options-compared): a freshly re-verified side-by-side of every mobile option, plus three cases where self-hosting anything is the wrong call
- [tmux and SSH keep Claude Code alive — they weren't designed for a phone](https://pocketshell.net/blog/why-tmux-and-ssh-arent-enough): what tmux + SSH already solve, what they don't (touch input, notifications, network switching), and what people reach for next

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/README.md): full feature list, quick start, install options, good-fit / not-a-fit guidance
- [README (中文)](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/README-CN.md): Chinese README
- [Interaction cheat sheet](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/USAGE.md): mobile gestures, key combos, the three key layouts (Classic / Layered / Flick) and the Fn app-command layer
- [Deployment guide](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/DEPLOYMENT.md): reverse proxy, TLS, running as a systemd or launchd service

## Source and releases

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell): Apache-2.0 source for the Bun agent and the Svelte frontend
- [Releases](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/releases): prebuilt binaries for linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-arm64 and darwin-x64, with SHA256SUMS.txt
- [Install script](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/install.sh): detects the platform, verifies the checksum, installs into PATH
- [License](https://github.com/Big-Pony/pocketshell/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0
